origin: Named after the merry-go-round (carousel): items rotate and come to the front in turn.
whenToUse: Content that takes turns in one spot, such as event banners.
You show a few photos one after another.
Space is tight and only one item can show at a time.
whenNotToUse: Information people must see (later slides are rarely seen).
Several items are compared (use horizontal scroll or a grid).

alternatives.name: Image Gallery
alternatives.reason: Choosing a photo to view large.

accessibility: Follow the WAI-ARIA carousel with aria-roledescription and slide names such as "1 of 3, Winter sale".
Auto-advance has a pause button and stops during hover and focus (WCAG 2.2.2).
With reduced motion, it doesn't advance on its own.
Only the current slide stays in the accessibility tree, and the dot buttons announce the position with aria-current.
